answer: Because the timing is written down against the grove challenge, the river audit can replay the nectar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 167 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2354 identities would post 4926 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
